mapper.sql: LEFT JOIN public.tb_dcs_receive_details detail ON detail.id = ( SELECT x.id FROM public.tb_dcs_receive_details x WHERE x.dcs_data_id = r.dcs_data_id AND x.parse_status = 'PARSED' ORDER BY x.id DESC LIMIT 1 )
mapper.select: SELECT TRIM(device_type) FROM public.tb_device WHERE device_id = CAST(#{deviceId} AS BIGINT)

SELECT TO_CHAR(r.received_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS receivedAt, NULLIF(CONCAT_WS(' / ', , '전압 ' || NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(detail.voltage AS TEXT)), '') ), '') AS dataPayload, TRIM(r.received_status) AS receivedStatus FROM public.tb_dcs_data r
WHERE r.device_id = CAST(#{deviceId} AS BIGINT) ORDER BY r.received_at DESC NULLS LAST, r.dcs_data_id DESC LIMIT 5

SELECT TO_CHAR(received_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS receivedAt, file_name AS dataPayload, TRIM(receive_status) AS receivedStatus FROM public.tb_ka_data WHERE device_id = CAST(#{deviceId} AS BIGINT) ORDER BY received_at DESC LIMIT 5
